api_key.description: API key of the Errbit app to access. Each app has its own unique API key.

base_url.description: Errbit instance base URL. Can also be set via ERRBIT_BASE_URL environment variable. Defaults to https://errbit.dialogapi.no

problem_id.description: Problem ID for get_problem, list_comments, and create_comment actions

start_date.description: Start date filter in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

end_date.description: End date filter in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z)
